answer: A weekly audit lottery keeps fake identities rare, and no farm can predict the draw. Each week, one identity in twenty faces a deep audit of its tools and past work, and must answer a live task within the hour. If the audit finds copied output or a shared payout route, its 1,400 POA audit bond burns and it is barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 140,000 POA. A falcon scout flies one honest route, a vine grows one tendril at a time, and a sonnet is written line by line — real standing is built the same slow way.
